problem_type: Selected media references must resolve to original project asset identity at the Agent input boundary
symptom: Video/audio accepted by Agent upload are treated as unreadable documents; local asset import receipts cannot form ready attachment claims
direct_cause: buildAgentUserContent routes non-images to document extraction; nomi-local import returns a synthetic identity without size/hash; attachment resolution only checks the first 500 assets; ready attachment effects checked lagging draft props and reinserted live atoms; onReady preceded view mounting; permanently mounted @ pool did not refresh after admission. Deletion diff also compared lagging draft props: clearing immediately after upload could leave the canonical claim and recovery reinserted the deleted atoms.
class_root: Presentation/reference selectors and provider input lack one complete canonical asset identity contract across media kinds and project size; admission and editor lifecycle require the live editor to own insertion presence, not asynchronously echoed draft props.
affected_population: Agent uploads and newly selected canvas/project references
internal_only_reason: Inspect installed @tiptap/core Editor.mount/create lifecycle and internal shared attachment/pool owners; no dependency or third-party wire format change.
invariants: Every ready selected reference is a canonical main-owned project asset claim, never a thumbnail or renderer-generated id
Every image/video/audio attachment enters the request as original bytes where supported or an explicit executable asset reference with honest limitations
All attachment claims resolve across every project asset page
Every inline reference remains bound to a visible canonical claim across draft restore, deletion and ACK-time edits
Inline numbering and send manifests use the same canonical claim identity/order; exact canvas source locators remain read-only context
Recovery reads the current editor document, not lagging owner echoes; mounted editor readiness and original asset pool refresh precede use.
Deletion uses the previous ProseMirror transaction document, so canonical claims are released even before the owner echoes an insertion.

door_reduction.why_not: Provider input must render content; desktop history must render attachment chips; runtime must restore drafts. All independently call the same canonical identity resolver. Door-map output for buildAgentUserContent and resolveProjectAgentAttachmentClaims captured before implementation. Composer and storyboard mention hosts converge on useComposerAttachments; import converges on importRemoteAssetToStore. No alternate writer added. PromptEditor callers share its mounted lifecycle; only Agent has attachment recovery, shared by upload, canvas and @. Existing source-pool refresh remains the owner.

generality_proof: Shared main canonical lookup and shared provider content builder cover upload, picker, history and restored messages independent of source kind or project list size.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Canonical paginated identity and file validation for every input.
Preserve executable original asset identities for all media; never treat video/audio as failed documents.
All Agent media admissions recover against the live editor document and refresh the existing source pool after canonical readiness.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uploaded original produces a canonical attachment claim; selected existing assets converge on the same state.
Current and historical messages resolve the same claims and share buildAgentUserContent.

recurrence.reason: Any video/audio attachment or old project asset beyond first page repeats the mechanism.
same_class_scan: rg buildAgentUserContent and resolveProjectAgentAttachmentClaims over electron/src
Inspected useAgentPanelV4Actions, useComposerAttachments, laneDesktopInput, laneDesktopAttachments, laneDesktopRuntime and projectAssetStore

prevention.invariant: Accepted original media identities cannot disappear into the document fallback.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing identity or missing original is rejected by main; unsupported semantic media is explicitly described as reference-only.
prevention.strategy: Keep one canonical attachment owner and emit exact asset ids into provider content independently of direct vision support. PromptEditor reports transaction.before to the same reference owner, removing props-lag from both insertion recovery and deletion.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove video/audio document extraction and synthetic local import receipt; no parallel fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Retain installed TipTap 3 mounted lifecycle API; onReady waits create/isInitialized, shared by all PromptEditor hosts. React owner echoes never override live insertion presence.
exit_criteria: Revalidate real mounted Editor create/readiness and rapid async reference/Shift+Enter walk on each TipTap major or mount-policy change.
dependency_lifecycle.target: Retain installed version with native create/isInitialized readiness and live Editor document insertion guards

migration: No stored schema change. Existing attachment claims and restored messages use the improved shared resolver.
residual_risks: Video/audio reference identity enables generation reuse, not native audiovisual understanding; actual provider and Windows journeys remain unverified until evidenced.

A canonical original shared by multiple canvas nodes has one media reference identity: context lists the explicit source nodes, and ambiguous edit instructions require a node name. No per-occurrence node identity is invented.
